about: Recorded pass rates of the oracle scorecard (test/fidelity/oracle-report.test.ts and test/browser/oracle-scorecard.test.ts), informational: each run reports its rates against them (tmp/oracle-report/gate.txt), and none of them fails a sample; a sample fails only when an element fails a property that oracle-known-failures.json does not list. Per sample with an oracle SVG in graph-io/test/fidelity/oracles/ (and <sample>@matched, the comparison with graphty's nodes at the program's own positions), per property of test/fidelity/oracle/compare-oracle.ts and per raster region (raster.<region>, 2 places, recorded from SwiftShader runs only: GRAPHTY_BROWSER_GPU unset, as CI runs). Stand-in oracles (another program's drawing, or a raster) keep theirs in standInFloors, and a sheet judged per setting (judges.ts) keeps its oracle's under <sample>, each stand-in's under <sample>~<route> in standInFloors and the specification's under <sample>~specification in specificationFloors. npm run fidelity:ratchet raises them to what a run measured and never lowers one; lowered is the history of floors lowered by hand before the rates stopped gating.
